summary: Lewis Hamilton's costly Singapore blunder hands Kimi Antonelli a golden opportunity to clinch the world championship at Circuit of the Americas, where Ferrari's prodigy needs only to finish ahead of the Mercedes driver to seal the title. McLaren's mid-field resurgence and Racing Bulls' driver retention drama provide secondary intrigue as teams jockey for constructor's points in a congested midfield battle. A victory for Antonelli would mark Ferrari's first championship in three seasons and cement the 18-year-old as the sport's newest generational talent, while Hamilton faces mounting pressure to salvage his season before departing Mercedes.
